general.notes: Operating Case Temperature range: 15 to +75°C. Short term operating case temperature range +80°C. Note: a short term condition is present for a period of not more than 96 consecutive hours and a total of not more than 15 days in 1 year. This refers to a total of 360 hours in any given year, but no more than 15 occurrences during that 1-year period. Note: the module turn up from cold start at ambient temperature as low as -5°C and it will warm up with a case temperature higher than the ambient temperature, but it will meet optical performance specs only with case temperature within the range defined above.
